observations: Front-loading washing machine with LG branding on the top left.
The detergent drawer is labeled 'Inverter DirectDrive 6/3kg'.
A red and white sticker on the front left identifies it as a 'Washer+Dryer 2in1'.
The control panel is powered on, with lights around the program dial and '---' on the digital display.
The machine has a silver or grey metallic finish.
The '2in1' sticker shows signs of peeling and wear.
The floor around the base of the machine appears to have water stains or dampness.
A power cord is visible on the right side, running upwards.

response.reason: The item is identified as an LG 6/3kg washer dryer. Although the seller's description is highly contradictory, the item can be priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional unit for repair or parts as explicitly stated by the seller.
